title: Steampunk festival next week
content: Attention Boston: I'll be a guest of the Watch City Steampunk Spectacular a week from now.I'll give a lecture on Dinotopia this coming Saturday at 2:00 p.m. and I'll be doing a lot of sketch-reporting all day Saturday.I would love to meet you, sign your book, or generally blow off a little steam.-----Watch City Festival,Waltham Massachusetts, May 11, 2013.Watch City Festival on Facebook
